level_semantics.finding: Day_1..Day_5 are comma-separated hazard code lists, not severity levels. Day*_Color is an internal WMS style parameter, not the public colour code.
level_semantics.source_of_truth: The IMD district warning page own script reads warnings_arr = nc["Day_" + day].split(",") and maps codes through its category table.
level_semantics.conclusion: A colour may be stated because it is monotone with the hazard tier in the data itself; the four public legend terms are rendered server-side by WMS and are not carried in the WFS attributes, so they are not claimed.

day_boundaries.derivation: Day n is the nth IST calendar day counted from the bulletin Date field, matching the day selector on the IMD page. IMD publishes no per-day validity field in this product.
day_boundaries.previous_state: adapters.warnings emitted valid_start_utc = None and temporal_applicability = "unresolved_day_boundaries"
